title: Screen PPI Calculator
description: Calculate a display's pixels-per-inch (PPI) from its diagonal size and resolution, plus megapixels and aspect ratio.
howto: Enter the screen diagonal in inches.
Enter the horizontal and vertical resolution in pixels.
Read the PPI, total megapixels and simplified aspect ratio.

faqs.a: Pixels per inch: the diagonal pixel count (by Pythagoras) divided by the diagonal screen size in inches. Higher PPI means sharper text and images.
Phones are usually 300-500 PPI, laptops 150-250 PPI, and desktop monitors 90-160 PPI. Above ~300 PPI at phone distance, pixels are invisible to most eyes.
Yes. Rendering more pixels costs GPU power, which is why games offer resolution scaling.
